A.summary: Public artifact vocabulary and ownership are unambiguous.
Protocol schemas are versioned, closed where required, bounded, and meta-validated.
Command semantics and canonical fixtures are deterministic.
Extension and theme ownership, lifecycle, collision, migration, and fallback rules are complete.
Host ports and capability negotiation cover all declared host responsibilities.
Media and rich-text boundaries identify Studio, host, and renderer responsibilities.
The security and privacy threat model and negative fixtures cover every trust boundary.
Errors and diagnostics are stable, localizable, and free of sensitive values.
TypeScript models compile and round-trip the canonical corpus for the Version 2 profile set.
Generic-host and Kumwe App playbooks map every required host responsibility to a public port.
Compatibility, deprecation, migration, and release policies are accepted.
Accessibility and non-drag interaction requirements are executable as conformance assertions.
Gate evidence is reproducible from a clean checkout and independently reviewed.
No unresolved critical or high-risk contradiction remains in a public contract.

B.summary: Every Gate A public contract is implemented or explicitly excluded through capability negotiation.
The fixed eight-package TypeScript release family installs from npm at one release coordinate.
The DOM-free TypeScript core passes applicable command, migration, and serialization fixtures.
The Lit shell exposes the complete semantic authoring operation set for the authoring-web profile.
Generic and Kumwe App hosts pass all required conformance and recovery behaviours.
Public rendering does not require Studio, privileged authoring APIs, or editor-only metadata.
Extension and theme examples survive their complete lifecycle without private APIs or data loss.
Existing and migrated documents remain readable, diagnosable, and safely renderable.
The Version 2 web accessibility matrix passes automated and manual qualification.
Security and resilience qualification has no unresolved critical or high issue.
Performance and package budgets are measured and enforced.
Builds, generated sources, fixtures, and release archives are deterministic or have verified nondeterminism.
SBOM, provenance, signatures, checksums, notes, support matrix, and recovery guide are published.
A clean-room external-host integration succeeds using documentation and public packages alone.
The Kumwe App vertical slice proves every declared integration responsibility.
Rollback and interrupted-upgrade drills preserve authoritative data and expose recovery.
All required evidence is attached to the exact release-candidate commit and remains fresh.
Independent reviewers approve without waiving a mandatory domain criterion.
